hero.definition: A smile makeover rebuilds or resurfaces up to 20 teeth with porcelain crowns, bridges or veneers, planned together so color, shape and bite match. Whitening and gum contouring are added when the design calls for them. At Xiluet Smiles in Miami the package costs $7,999, includes a professional cleaning and X-rays, is delivered in 5 business days and carries a 5-year written warranty.
hero.lead: Up to 20 crowns, bridges or veneers from one plan and one in-house lab, with whitening and gum contouring when your smile needs them. Delivered in 5 business days in Miami, with a 5-year warranty in writing.

candidates.title: For smiles with more than one thing to fix
candidates.intro: Crowns, bridges and veneers are chosen tooth by tooth, then designed as one smile. Whitening and gum contouring join the plan when needed.

items.d: Old fillings and crowns breaking one after another.
Teeth too damaged for a veneer are rebuilt with a crown.
Whitening first so the porcelain is matched to your final shade; the gum line evened to frame the teeth.
Dark metal margins and mismatched colors replaced in one plan.
Years of grinding have shortened your teeth and aged your face.

price.title: One price for 20 crowns or veneers, in writing
price.body: Send photos and a doctor replies with your treatment plan within 6 hours. Individual crowns and bridges are $500 each when done with your smile design, veneers $1,000; the $7,999 package covers a full set of 20. Whitening, gum contouring, deep cleaning and other procedures are itemised separately, in writing, before anything starts.
price.footnote: Prices shown are minimum fees. Your final fee is confirmed in writing after a doctor's evaluation.

faq.title: Makeover questions, answered by the doctors

items.q: Crown, bridge or veneer: who decides?
items.a: Your doctor, tooth by tooth, at Visit 1. A veneer covers the front of a healthy tooth; a crown rebuilds a broken or heavily filled one; a bridge replaces a missing tooth using the neighbors. You confirm the plan before any preparation.
Preparation is done under local anesthesia. Expect soreness for a few days, managed with over-the-counter pain relief.
Porcelain does not whiten, which is why we whiten first and match the veneers and crowns to the result.
Done under local anesthesia. Expect mild tenderness for a few days.
Crowns and bridges are often classed as major restorative work and may be covered 50 to 80 percent depending on your plan. We give you the codes for your claim.
Porcelain and zirconia restorations typically last 10 to 30 years with good care. Ours carry a 5-year written warranty.

items.q: Can it be done in 3 days?
items.a: Yes. Rush delivery in 3 business days is $10,000 instead of $7,999, because the lab works on your case exclusively. Most patients choose the standard 5-day schedule.
Mild crowding is handled by the veneers and crowns. Severe misalignment needs aligners first, which adds months to the plan.
